adaptations: No borrowed query plans retain context/control/provider references.
No fake clip provider or default rendering resource is supplied; fixture clip provider exists only in tests.
The accepted scene model assigns source at append time and exposes immutable published views.
The accepted SceneView::shape_id(index) enumerator safely includes zero-edge shapes and guards stale/foreign identities.
C allocator call count/pointer identity is not claimed; stats count explicit admitted capacity leases and actual overlap.

ChargeLedger exposes no reservation transaction or history rollback. To keep failed physical reservation history unchanged, reserve_table uses exclusive-borrow available-byte preflight, then admits actual capacity before publishing. Strict lease admission before physical allocation and rollback of that admission cannot both be guaranteed with this shared API.
